{{Infobox mineral |name = Earth Crystal |image = Earth Crystal.png |source = {{Name|The Mines Icon|link=The Mines}}{{Name|Geode}}{{Name|Omni Geode}}{{Name|Duggy|10%}}{{Name|Haunted Skull|1.30%}}{{Name|Wilderness Golem|0.5%}}{{Name|Iridium Golem|0.5%}}{{Name|Copper Pan}}{{Name|Fishing Treasure Chest|link=Fishing#Treasure Chests{{!}}Fishing}} |sellprice = 50 |profession = y }} An '''Earth Crystal''' is a type of [[Minerals|Mineral]]. It can be foraged in [[The Mines]] (especially floors 1 - 39), or obtained from [[Geode]]s and [[Omni Geode]]s, dropped from [[Duggy|Duggies]] in the Mines (floors 1 - 29), dropped from [[Haunted Skull]]s, or from [[Pans|panning]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or in a [[Garbage Can]]. Earth Crystals can be destroyed by [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |dislike=Linus,Pierre }} ==Bundles== Earth Crystal is used in the {{Bundle|geologist||y}}. ==Recipes== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source |- |[[File:Mayonnaise Machine.png]] |[[Mayonnaise Machine]] |{{Description|Mayonnaise Machine}} |{{Name|Wood|15}}{{Name|Stone|15}}{{Name|Earth Crystal|1}}{{Name|Copper Bar|1}} |[[File:Farming Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Farming]] Level 2 |- |} ==Buildings== Earth Crystal is required to purchase the [[Earth Obelisk]] from the [[Wizard's Tower]]. {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Cost !Size |- |[[File:Earth Obelisk.png|48px|center]] |[[Earth Obelisk]] |{{Description|Earth Obelisk}} |{{Price|500000}}{{Name|Iridium Bar|10}}{{Name|Earth Crystal|10}} |style="text-align: center;"|'''3x2'''
[[File:Marker3x2.png|center|3x2]] |} ==Tailoring== Earth Crystal is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[File:Shirt094.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *Earth Crystal may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|150}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. *5 Earth Crystal are requested by [[Stonefish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. *1-2 Earth Crystal may be requested by [[Bullhead]], [[Catfish]], or [[Largemouth Bass]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7. ==History== {{History|1.1|Used as a building material to the [[Earth Obelisk]].}} {{History|1.3.27|Can be found in [[Omni Geode]]s.}} {{History|1.4|[[Sturdy Ring]] does not use Earth Crystal to craft anymore. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].}} {{History|1.6|Can be obtained from [[Iridium Golem]]s.
